gate_before_HC_collapse.qualification: Finite scalar f32/BF16-RNE model. Gate chosen as f32(sigmoid(sqrt(2^-14))), consistent with positive scalar gate formula. Not actual frozen weight outputs or native gate/HcPre instruction parity.

preweight_key_reassociation.qualification: Finite input FP32 overflow counterexample to unconditional reassociation; native saturation/precision remains a separate contract.

exact_scalar_hoist: Cache key_rstd=rsqrt(mean(key.float()**2)+eps) in original FP32 arithmetic; later execute original hidden_rstd*=key_rstd and original raw dot/order. Do not replace with normalized/preweighted key.
